title: How calls survive disconnects — data examples and schemas

cards.name: Call tasks
fields: id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
request_hash TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL
created INTEGER NOT NULL; UTC acceptance milliseconds
expires INTEGER NOT NULL; created plus 30 days
month TEXT NOT NULL; UTC month
active INTEGER NOT NULL
next_check INTEGER NOT NULL
allowance INTEGER NOT NULL; USD microdollars
body TEXT NOT NULL; Task JSON
uses: Durable call coordinator -> SQLite storage: Persist before the provider request [persist]

cards.name: Used request hashes
fields: request_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY; SHA-256 only

cards.name: Aggregate accounted costs and reservations
fields: month TEXT PRIMARY KEY
micros INTEGER NOT NULL

cards.name: Unresolved-call lock
fields: reason TEXT PRIMARY KEY; no private call content

cards.name: Fresh provider conversation
fields: agent_id, agent_phone_number_id, to_number: configured identities and validated destination
conversation_initiation_client_data.user_id: durable call UUID
conversation_initiation_client_data.dynamic_variables: task_type, objective, context, owner_name, callback_number, voicemail_action/message
success_criteria and all constraints arrays are JSON-encoded strings inside dynamic_variables
conversation_config_override.conversation.max_duration_seconds: approved duration
call_recording_enabled: false
telephony_call_config.ringing_timeout_secs: 60
uses: Durable call coordinator -> ElevenLabs telephone agent: Initiate once with fresh context [start]

cards.name: Raw ElevenLabs conversation
fields: agent_id, conversation_id, user_id: identities
status: initiated, in-progress, processing, done or failed
metadata: start_time_unix_secs, call_duration_secs, cost_fiat, Twilio phone identity
transcript: timed role/message/tool turns
analysis: summary and collected outcome/confirmation/unresolved values
has_audio: recording availability
uses: Durable call coordinator -> ElevenLabs telephone agent: Read conversation; returns raw provider evidence [evidence]

cards.name: Raw Twilio call state
fields: sid, account_sid, from, to: checked identities
status: telephone status
price and price_unit: nullable billed amount and currency
start_time and duration: nullable provider values
uses: Durable call coordinator -> Twilio telephone connection: Read telephone status and charge [read-call]

cards.name: Provider admission facts
fields: ElevenLabs reads: complete agent configuration, phone assignment, subscription credits
Twilio reads: account identity/type, number primary/fallback routing, USD balance, destination USD rate
Seven concurrent read responses; invalid or unavailable facts reject admission before a task exists
uses: Durable call coordinator -> ElevenLabs telephone agent: Check agent, number and credits before admission [admit-eleven]
Durable call coordinator -> Twilio telephone connection: Check account, routing, balance and current rate before admission [admit-twilio]

cards.name: Durable provider read ordering
fields: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1)
sequence INTEGER NOT NULL; monotonically increasing observation number, no call content
